callouts.label: Happy
callouts.hint: A child smiling with open arms in warm sunshine.
callouts.description: Happy can feel light, warm, energetic, or smiley. Naming it helps us share joy.
callouts.ap_tip: Tell someone what made you happy.

callouts.label: Sad
callouts.hint: A child sitting quietly beneath a small raincloud while an adult listens.
callouts.description: Sad may come with tears, low energy, or wanting comfort. A trusted adult can listen and help.
callouts.ap_tip: If sadness stays a long time, always tell a trusted adult.

callouts.label: Angry or Frustrated
callouts.hint: A child with a tight face and wind-blown leaves nearby.
callouts.description: Anger and frustration are strong feelings. Safe choices include pausing, breathing, and using words.
callouts.ap_tip: Feelings are okay; hurting people or things is not.

callouts.label: Worried
callouts.hint: A child holding their tummy as swirly wind moves nearby.
callouts.description: Worry can make a tummy feel jumpy or thoughts race. Naming the worry can make help easier to find.
callouts.ap_tip: Try: “I feel worried. Can you help me?”

callouts.label: Excited
callouts.hint: A child running happily beneath a bright flying kite.
callouts.description: Excitement can bring fast energy, big smiles, and lots of movement.
callouts.ap_tip: Use that energy in a safe space.

callouts.label: Scared
callouts.hint: A child reaching for a calm adult beneath distant storm clouds.
callouts.description: Fear can warn us to seek safety. Moving near and telling a trusted adult is a strong choice.
callouts.ap_tip: You never have to handle a scary feeling alone.

callouts.label: Calm
callouts.hint: A child breathing slowly beside still water.
callouts.description: Calm may feel steady, relaxed, and ready to think. Slow breathing can help the body settle.
callouts.ap_tip: Notice your shoulders and breathing when you feel calm.

callouts.label: Lonely or Left Out
callouts.hint: A child sitting apart while a caring teacher approaches.
callouts.description: Feeling left out can hurt. A trusted adult can listen and help make room for belonging.
callouts.ap_tip: It is brave to ask for help joining in.
